title: C: Markdown Parser (Simulated)
description: Parse simple Markdown syntax (headings, bold, italics) and convert to HTML.

steps.title: Parse Headings
steps.description: Write a function `void parse_heading(char *line)` that detects Markdown headings (#, ##, ###) and converts them to HTML `<h1>`, `<h2>`, `<h3>`. Test with '# Title', '## Section', '### Subsection'.
hints: Wrap in `<hN>...</hN>` where N is the count.
